text:
mike: CI helm lint is failing on the gpu chart in the gitops pipeline, started after the values-schema bump.

mike: Error from chart-testing: 
```
Error: values.schema.json: fails 'anyOf' at /gpu/pools/0/selector
- 'required' failed for: nodeSelector or nodeAffinity
```

mike: But our values have selector: {} in overlays, which used to be accepted.

jess: ugh, schema strictness got tightened in the last PR. which pipeline? staging or prod?

mike: staging gitops (cluster-staging). It blocks the helm-release job so deploys aren't proceeding.

tara: can you paste the values that hit the failure?

mike: sure — overlay values snippet: 
```
gpu:
  pools:
    - name: t4-shared
      selector: {}
      capacity: 8
```

jess: schema now has anyOf: [ {required: ["nodeSelector"]}, {required: ["nodeAffinity"]} ] so empty map fails. It used to treat {} as no-op.

liam: that change was to prevent accidental empty selectors being interpreted as wildcard — it makes autoscaler scheduling explicit. But we probably need a more permissive coerce in the template helpers.

mike: deploy-bot also reported a lint failure in the precommit: `ct lint --charts ./charts/gpu --values overlays/staging.yaml`

deploy-bot: @channel chart-testing job failed: helm lint errors in charts/gpu (see job #4821) :warning:

jess: quick workaround: change selector: {} to omit selector key entirely in overlays. That should pass, but it's noisy across a dozen overlays.

tara: can we update the values.schema.json to accept empty object explicitly? e.g. allow {} by adding a nullable/empty-object schema branch?

liam: we tried that before — JSON Schema doesn't have a great 'empty object allowed only' idiom without opening the door to incorrect shapes. But we can add a helper in chart that treats selector: {} as null at render time with coalesce.

mike: snippet idea for helpers/_selectors.tpl: 
```
{{- define "gpu.selector" -}}
{{- if or (not .selector) (eq .selector dict) -}}
  # no selector
{{- else -}}
  {{ toYaml .selector | nindent 2 }}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
```

jess: careful: eq .selector dict might not be reliable depending on Sprig functions. Also helm template unit tests caught that eq dict pattern before.

liam: alternative: coerce in values via a small precommit script that normalizes overlays: remove explicit empty maps. We already have a k8s-values-sanitizer job (refs: values-sanitizer) — could add a rule.

tara: I don't love adding more hacks to precommit. This is a schema vs templates mismatch. For clarity, I'd prefer either: 1) revert the schema tightening and add an explicit comment about selector required, or 2) migrate overlays to omit empty selector and add a lint autofix.

mike: option 2 seems safe but manual migration cost is high. How many overlays? ~12 across clusters.

jess: I can run a quick grep+patch in the repo to delete `selector: {}` occurrences and open a PR with automated commit. Won't touch any non-gpu charts.

liam: if you do that, add a small note in CHARTS-README about required selector semantics so future authors don't reintroduce empty maps. Also add a ct config to treat schema errors as blockers (we already do) so team knows why.

mike: sounds good. jess, want me to review the PR?

jess: yes please. I'll also add a gitops job ticket to coordinate redeploy once chart-testing succeeds.

deploy-bot: created issue CI-1294 for chart lint fail and linked job #4821.

tara: long-term, we should consider updating values-schema to allow a sentinel like `selector: null` or `selector: {matchAll: true}` instead of empty map. That'd be explicit for intent.

liam: agreed. I'll draft a small RFC for selector semantics and submit to eng-platform this week.

mike: thanks all. I'll queue up the grep+patch and tag you when ready. :thumbsup:

jess: thanks — will watch the pipeline.

liam: ping me if the ct job still flakes after the patches, might be other overlays from partners repo.

mike: END
